newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines raises petroleum products prices.
newsitem.headline: Philippines raises petroleum products prices.

text.p: The Philippines' Energy Regulatory Board (ERB) announced on Thursday an average price hike of 26 centavos per litre on all petroleum products.
ERB chairman Arnaldo Baldonado told Reuters by phone that liquefied petroleum gas will be raised the most by 50 centavos a litre, followed by diesel at 35.65 centavos, and kerosene at 33.33 centavos.

Baldonado said price of jet fuel will be increased by 30.19 centavos per litre, regular gasoline by 20.93 centavos, unleaded premium gasoline by 15.86 centavos, and premium gasoline by 14.76 centavos.
Fuel oil, used in the country mainly for power generation, will have a minimal price increase of 2.53 centavos, Baldonado said.
The price adjustments will take effect on Friday at 6 a.m.
"We are just reflecting the movements in Singapore Posted Prices which have risen significantly," said Baldonado.
The adjustment is the sixth since the government started implementing an automatic oil price formula last August as a step towards full deregulation of the oil industry.
